text:
marta: FYI ran the node + python sample suites together and hit two annoyances: python SDK default log level is WARNING (node is INFO), and our OTEL header injection is occasionally losing X-Request-Id because of a redaction helper.

ajohnson: can you share a tiny repro/snippet?

marta: steps: checkout sample-apps, run both: 
```
# run from repo root
REDWOOD_OTEL_ENABLED=1 REDWOOD_SDK_LOG_LEVEL=debug ./scripts/run-two-samples.sh
```
logs: 
```
[2027-05-02T09:31:12Z] INFO  node-sdk: outgoing req headers={"x-request-id":"rid-42"}
[2027-05-02T09:31:12Z] WARNING python-sdk: retry attempt 1 (span missing request id)
```
The request header is emitted by client but the span attribute ends up without the id.

sam: i dug in briefly: python has a `strip_sensitive_query_params()` util that uses a regex to redact any `key|id` pairs in query strings. it's matching `request-id=` because of the `id` token.

olivia: oof. the redaction config in redaction-config.json is scoped to auth tokens, but the python util went greedy. we should adopt a whitelist approach (only redact known auth params) rather than blacklisting substrings.

marta: agreed. also noticed the OTEL hook registration differs: node registers its inject hook during SDK.init(), python does it at import time which changes ordering when apps do lazy init. we should standardize to init-time registration to avoid races.

ajohnson: proposed action items: 1) change python redaction to whitelist auth params (authorization, token, api_key, api-key), 2) move python otel hook registration to init(), 3) align default log level across SDKs (INFO), 4) add e2e test asserting X-Request-Id is present in span attributes.

devex-bot: Test suggestion: CI job should start a lightweight app pair, send single request with X-Request-Id header, export OTLP to an in-test collector, then assert span attributes contain "http.request_id"==<header>. Fail CI if missing. Also add flaky guard with retry to avoid transient startup races.

sam: i'll open a patch for the python util and log-level bump. i'll also add a small unit test for the regex behavior. PR will target main and i will backport to 1.x after review.

olivia: i'll handle the OTEL hook change and update the sample-app to call sdk.init() explicitly in examples. i'll add a short note to the SDK migration guide.

marta: i'll add the end-to-end test to sample-apps/ci and wire up the OTLP collector job. will post PRs: sample-apps and python-sdk.

ajohnson: thanks — once PRs are up, please drop links here so I can mark for backport and add to the release notes.

marta: quick patch PRs: python-redaction -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/198, sample-apps e2e -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/431

sam: opened python PR for regex + log level change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/199 :arrow_up_small:

devex-bot: Reminder: update devex/compat-matrix to reflect log-level parity and otel-hook lifecycle change.

marta: great. i'll validate once CI passes and then request reviews for backports. thanks all :tada:
